statement: The actual degree-nine elliptic covering gives explicit rank-five and rank-thirteen quotients of the intrinsic cubic pro-three group. The latter retains all ten abelian coordinates, is exactly the fiber product of the cuspidally central quotient and the ambient class-three quotient over their specified common quotient, and has a fully evaluated genuine based Frobenius at the prime of Q(zeta_3) above two. The actual discriminant-root transport and the rank-forty kernel in the larger rank-fifty-three quotient are retained.
where_proved: sections/E_elliptic_frobenius.tex, E58.1-E58.23 and complete proof; code/a_elliptic_frobenius.py/.out/.json and code/a_elliptic_rank13.py/.out/.json
manuscript_passages: Section51.16, folios733v-736v, scans172-178, equations(371)-(379), Part E(c),(d)
notes: The rational cubic-to-Weierstrass morphism and its inverse are displayed. Its tangent coefficient is1/3, and the actual multiplication-by-three cover gives coefficient1, proving the based comparison.
The integral equality J intersect m^2 = Jm proves the exact fiber-product map. The commutator modules of B,R,P_3 have ranks51,11,3; their displayed kernels have ranks40,48,8,2.
The free rank-eleven ring has an actual carry multiplication and inverse normal-form maps. The exact lower-central lattices give gamma2/gamma3 = Z3 plus (Z/9)^2; this torsion is retained in E60.

The genuine action factors through the actual image of (rho_E,kappa_Delta). The proof uses Nakamura equation3.6.3 and Theorem6.10.3, then proves agreement of the reference Tate map on the exact killed ideal before calculating Frobenius.

Over K_v=Q2(zeta_3), residue4, the actual Tate Frobenius is scalar -2. The principal discriminant-root Kummer value is3/2, while the Q2-root value is0. Their root ratio, actual T1(1/2) conjugacy, and relative Int(c^(1/8)) correction are displayed and checked.
The Frobenius formula is given on all thirteen coordinates, with integral denominators. The full based action on the retained rank-forty kernel of B remains an arithmetic input.

Root independently checked the complete proof. B reopened the original source and reran both programs in a separate copy with matching JSON; detailed audit is ledger/bc_e58_audit.md. Later cosmetic edits clarify the three-adic character and Kummer output label without changing an arithmetic value.
